# Third-party teaching runtimes

These pinned distributions are included locally so lessons do not depend on a CDN at runtime. Their original headers are retained. They are not covered by the project's copyright notice.

| Distribution | Version | License | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vue | 3.5.22 | [MIT](vue.LICENSE) | https://github.com/vuejs/core |
| React | 18.3.1 | [MIT](react.LICENSE) | https://github.com/facebook/react |
| React DOM | 18.3.1 | [MIT](react-dom.LICENSE) | https://github.com/facebook/react |
| Vue Router | 4.5.1 | [MIT](vue-router.LICENSE) | https://github.com/vuejs/router |
| Pinia | 3.0.3 | [MIT](pinia.LICENSE) | https://github.com/vuejs/pinia |

License texts were retrieved from the corresponding versioned npm distributions on unpkg. Review upstream licensing and lesson compatibility whenever upgrading.
